title: CommunityPasteCreateRequest
description: community.paste-create-request@1: the body of POST /api/pastes on OpenVibe.Community (community.paste.create). A JSON text paste needs content (non-blank, at most the configured size, 512 KB by default); a multipart body with a `screenshot` image part (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, 8 MB by default; also POST /api/pastes/screenshot) makes an image paste. Visibility other than unlisted or private is public, and an ownerless private paste becomes unlisted. slug (public pastes only), metadata and ai_summary/ai_tags are honoured from a service token only; a browser's are ignored. Unknown fields are ignored. The answer is { id, slug, url, paste } with 201.

title.description: Trimmed to 200 characters; Untitled (Screenshot for an image) when blank.

language.description: A language hint; auto or absent sniffs it from the content.

burn_after_read.description: Truthy (true, 1, '1', 'true', 'on'): gone after the first read by someone else.

stream_id.description: The Live stream it was made during (digits).

description.description: Multipart screenshot: the text shown under the image.

page_url.description: Multipart screenshot: the page it shows.

slug.description: Service callers, public pastes only: the slug to use (409 if taken).

metadata.description: Service callers only: a JSON object (at most 16 KB).

ai_tags.description: Service callers only, with ai_summary: JSON text or a value to serialise.
